newsitem.title: USA: Phillips Petroleum seeks to boost share price. [CORRECTED 21:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Phillips Petroleum seeks to boost share price. [CORRECTED 21:50 GMT]

text.p: Phillips Petroleum Co will take action to boost its share price, the company's chief executive, Wayne Allen (corrects from William Allen), said on Tuesday at the Howard Weil Energy Conference.
"We are talking with our advisors and are taking action to improve that (the company's share price)," Allen said, although he did not immediately elaborate.
Phillips' shares stood at 40 in late trading Tuesday, up 3/4.
